title: Program output vertex bound
statement: Let $n,m,w$ be natural numbers, let the instruction kinds form a type with a designated default, and let $F$ assign a Boolean-list function to each kind. For any program, instruction index $i$ less than the program length, and output-bit index $j<w$, the vertex assigned to bit $j$ of instruction $i$ is strictly less than the base vertex immediately after that instruction.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is less than the program length
